projects.title: Small-Image Classification Capstone
bullets: Loaded public small-image datasets from natural-scene collections using Python and NumPy for a supervised undergraduate capstone on classification under input changes.
Trained a compact image classifier using PyTorch and summarized classification errors as assigned capstone tasks.

research.title: Handwritten-Symbol Image Classification
bullets: Loaded public small-image datasets from handwritten-symbol collections using Python and NumPy as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Applied simple input transformations and trained a compact image classifier using PyTorch for the supervised study of classification under input changes.

research.title: Static Checks for Programming Exercises
bullets: Implemented abstract syntax-tree traversal in Python for static checks on public file-processing example programs as part of supervised faculty research.
Wrote checks for selected code patterns and documented false-positive cases in the programming examples as assigned research assistance tasks.
